definitions.explanation: Tools and instruments used to prepare and cook food, such as knives, ladles, whisks, spatulas, and peelers. Usually refers to hand tools rather than large appliances.

examples.japanese: {調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}を{揃|そろ}える。
examples.english: To get a set of cooking utensils.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}き{出|だ}しに{調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}が{入|はい}っている。
examples.english: Cooking utensils are in the drawer.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}を{買|か}ったので、{料理|りょうり}が{楽|たの}しくなった。
examples.english: I bought new cooking utensils, which made cooking more enjoyable.

examples.japanese: {使|つか}い{終|お}わった{調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}は、すぐに{洗|あら}って{清潔|せいけつ}に{保|たも}ちましょう。
examples.english: Cooking utensils should be washed right after use to keep them clean.

notes:
A general term for tools used in cooking. Literally {調理|ちょうり} (cooking) + {用具|ようぐ} (tools, implements).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}を{揃|そろ}える: to get a set of cooking utensils
- {調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}を{洗|あら}う: to wash cooking utensils
- {調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}{一式|いっしき}: a full set of cooking utensils
- {基本|きほん}の{調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}: basic cooking utensils
- アウトドア{用|よう}{調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}: outdoor cooking utensils

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {調理器具|ちょうりきぐ}: cooking implements — very close in meaning; may imply slightly larger tools including some small appliances
- {台所|だいどころ}{用品|ようひん}: kitchen goods — broader, including containers, cleaning items, and consumables
- キッチン{用品|ようひん}: kitchen goods — the more modern version of {台所|だいどころ}{用品|ようひん}
- {鍋|なべ}{釜|かま}: pots and pans (fixed expression)

EXAMPLES OF {調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}:
- {包丁|ほうちょう}: kitchen knife
- まな{板|いた}: cutting board
- お{玉|たま}: ladle
- フライ{返|がえ}し: spatula
- {泡立|あわだ}て{器|き}: whisk
- {菜箸|さいばし}: cooking chopsticks
- {計量|けいりょう}カップ: measuring cup
